special_traits.name: Spider Climb
special_traits.description:
The ettercap can climb difficult surfaces,
including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

special_traits.name: Web Walker
special_traits.description:
The ettercap ignores movement re-
strictions caused by webs, and the ettercap knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description:
The ettercap makes one Bite attack and
one Claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description:
Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2)
Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the ettercap's next turn.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description:
Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2)
Slashing damage.

actions.name: DC 12, one Large or smaller creature the ettercap can see within 30 feet
actions.description: Failure: The target has the Restrained condition until the web is destroyed (AC 10; HP 5; Vulnerability to Fire damage; Immunity to Bludgeoning, Poison, and Psychic damage).

bonus_actions.name: Reel
bonus_actions.description:
The ettercap pulls one creature within 30 feet of
itself that is Restrained by its Web Strand up to 25 feet straight toward itself.
